call_framework.opening: Hi [name], it's James Hardstaff here. I run a company called Not Forgotten — we help painting businesses make sure no quote goes cold. I sent you a quick email earlier this week. Did you happen to see it?
call_framework.if_no: No worries at all — I know how busy it gets. The short version is: we help painters follow up quotes automatically so nothing falls through the cracks. I was curious if that's something you deal with.
discovery_questions: How many quotes do you send out in a typical month?
What happens after a quote goes out — do you have a system for following up?
Roughly what percentage would you say actually convert?
What's the biggest reason you think quotes don't turn into jobs?
If you could wave a magic wand and fix one thing about your quoting process, what would it be?

objection_handling.not_interested: Fair enough — appreciate the honesty. Mind if I ask: is it because you've already got a system that works, or is follow-up just not something you worry about?
objection_handling.already_follow_up: That's great — most don't. What do you use? (Listen.) Most of our clients were following up manually before they came to us — the issue was consistency, not effort.
objection_handling.send_information: Happy to. What's the best email? I'll send you a one-pager. No pressure — just so you've got it if you ever want to revisit.
objection_handling.too_busy: I won't keep you. Quick question — are you on the tools yourself? (If yes.) That's exactly why we built this. When you're painting all day, follow-up is the first thing that slips.
objection_handling.who_are_you: Totally fair. I'm James — I run Not Forgotten. We're a small Australian company that built a follow-up system specifically for trade businesses. I reached out because I thought what we do might help someone like you.
objection_handling.how_much: It depends on your quote volume — typically between $200-500/month for a painting business your size. But I'd rather understand whether it'd actually help you before we talk numbers.
